8060.title: Ladle stories replace the core plugin runtime with a test runtime
8060.rootCauseOneLine: Core-hosted Ladle stories install the testing SDK, whose hooks require an absent test slot context; Ladle also omits its virtual-Zod resolver.

prReviews.verdict: Static direction matches the verified mechanisms; not executed
prReviews.topFinding: Existing open PR closes #8060, so no duplicate fix was created.

8060.proposedFix: Remove test runtime installation from core-hosted stories, use the core workflow registration collector, and install the existing Ladle Zod resolver.
8060.caveats: Two clean story-render and static-build reproductions. Browser access was unavailable across hosts; no visual or pass-after-PR claim.
